verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe 'Browse with Copilot', which performs actions directly in Microsoft Edge (clicking, typing, navigating tabs). Steps are visible in real time, the user can take control, and Copilot asks for supervision before buying items or booking reservations, so it clearly completes website tasks on the user's behalf. Cowork covers broader multi-step tasks. Missing for 10: any independent or hands-on corroboration that browsing works reliably, explicit documentation of agentic browsing for research (beyond web-grounded answers and Researcher), and support for browsers other than Edge.
